title: SmooBack Dark
description: A smooth and dark menu background using SmooPack colours
body:
# SmooBack Dark

SmooBack (Smooth Background) Dark changes the menu background(s) to be fully opaque and use the colour scheme used in [SmooGUI Dark](https://modrinth.com/project/smoogui-dark).

**Important!** There are two versions you can download:

+ Out Of World: Only changes the menu background when you're not in a world (and leaves it unchanged otherwise)
+ All Menus: Also replaces the in-world menu background.

## SmooPacks

Check out all currently available SmooBacks in the [SmooBack Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/VZGPEYKa).

If you want to smoothen your HUD as well, download any of the [SmooHUD Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/R1YmDDaC).

If you want to have a uniquely coloured Hotbar Selector for your SmooHUD, download any of the [SmooHUD Selector Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/eRZkOenV). This will become useful only if and once I add more colour schemes, as then you'll be able to mix and match colours.

If you want to overhaul the rest of your GUI in the same style as SmooBack, download any of the [SmooGUI Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/QRoetCy4).
